title: Fantastic!
text:
Fantastic!. Doesn't take long to charge, it's lightweight, has great suction, easily goes under furniture, great rotation and gets in the corners perfectly! I do think the price is a little high but it requires no bags and empties very easily.

I've been wanting to update this. After using about 6 months, there is the part you can clip the bottom on with and it broke. Now the bottom just falls off of the vacuum. It's not a replaceable item, therefore it's kind of useless unless you duct tape it.
